status: read-only design; native event-local gain/auto-fade/PCM gate still being established by other agents
recommendation: Add a separately named single-event source-rate PCM preparation/export path. Preserve the frozen unresolved event, original report and ordinary project playback/export refusals.

existing_paths.fact: Validates current project, replayed source/report clock and event identity/track membership, selected file metadata/hash, and all linked event segments. Native provenance and attachment validators are private.
existing_paths.implication: The smallest public entry starts from a saved package and eventID; it can call ProjectStore.load. Unsaved-session support needs a shared internal proof validator, never caller-supplied success booleans.

existing_paths.fact: Current internal archive decoder retains native event volume bits, inversion, both fades, empty curve datum, clip attributes, ancestor records, segment/file identity and raw coordinates. It rejects nonempty numeric event attributes/nonempty volume-curve children.
existing_paths.implication: Re-decode preserved original bytes for new processing gates. Existing UnresolvedCPRAudioEvent intentionally lacks many processing fields and must not be silently treated as a complete render authorization.

existing_paths.fact: Preparation requires no unresolved events, then independently applies application timeline frame rounding, Float64 linear interpolation, Double gain/pan automation and final Float32 conversion. Stable track/clip order defines Float32 mix accumulation.
existing_paths.implication: Do not route recovered native events through this preparation merely because their placement is known.

existing_paths.fact: Transport consumes AudioPreparation and one AVAudioPlayerNode per prepared clip; StudioSession separately guards play and mix export with requireResolvedAudioEvents. Hardware and AVAudioEngine rendering are additional stages.
existing_paths.implication: An event-local PCM artifact is a different acceptance boundary from timeline or device playback. An eventual preview may consume that PCM explicitly while leaving ordinary project transport blocked.

proposed_api.entry: CPRLocalEventRenderer.render(eventID: UUID, fromPackage: URL, to: URL) throws -> CPRLocalEventRenderReceipt
proposed_api.alternative_for_streaming: Internal prepare returns a privately constructed immutable proof/asset snapshot; a bounded chunk reader renders from that same snapshot. No public initializer accepts a trusted=true or backendAvailable=true flag.
receipt_fields: source CPR SHA256, frozen interpretation profile and new processing contract
selected asset SHA256 and explicit user-selected association
sample rate, channels, sample format, frame count
output PCM/file checksum and exact processing scope
proposed_api.state_policy: No mutation of Project, original CPR, ImportReport or attachment. No generated Clip and no replacement of the unresolved event.

finite_acceptance_gate: Replay the frozen source/profile and retain the exact event under its original track. Reject modified event projections or source proof.
Bind selected media to the original AudioFile identity and hash. Matching format does not prove the recording is the unavailable original.
Decode/hash the same immutable bounded asset bytes or stable handle-backed snapshot used by the renderer; validation followed by reopening a mutable path is not a byte custody guarantee.
Require exactly one segment/file identity and checked nonnegative native Offset/Length/Start intervals; use CPRSegmentReadPlan for direct-read bounds and ordinary full-read branch only.

Require the verified native selector predicates, native rate equality, native gain operation/order and inherited automatic-fade flags zero under their exact source binding. Unknown/inconsistent predicates reject; absent serialized fields are not generic proof of inactive hosted processing.

Use an explicit native PCM decode/convert kernel once original-byte evidence binds its PCM24 conversion and output precision. AVAudioFile Float32 conversion is useful decoding infrastructure but is not by itself that proof.

Keep LoFi output at its selected 44100 Hz rate. Its imported 48000 Hz project rate is an application default. The new rate-budget kernel provides counts only and cannot authorize unequal-rate sample conversion.
Bound frames/bytes/output RIFF sizes before work; reject short or changed reads, nonfinite data and unsupported processing. Stage output and promote only after complete successful validation.
ordinary_timeline_blockers: Recovered source track skeleton controls (0 dB, centered, unmuted, unsoloed, empty automation) are application defaults, not recovered native mixer facts.

Track/project inherited processing, inserts, routing, gain/pan/mute/solo automation, overlap accumulation order, channel layout and remaining native content need their own supported reconstruction gates.
An event-local direct PCM proof does not reconstruct omitted MIDI/instrument content or the entire project mix.
Generic application linear resampling and pan/gain laws are not substitutes for native rate-converter or mixer evidence.
recommended_tests: Pinned LoFi source with a self-authored matching PCM asset: exact 1058400-frame/44100-Hz source-rate result, no inserted leading silence or application-rate conversion, source/report/current event unchanged.

Independent exact PCM24 edge/LSB/sign/channel and Float32 gain vectors once native conversion is bound; distinguish multiply order and chunk boundaries, tails over8192 and nonzero segment Start/Offset.

One-gate-at-a-time controls: nonzero inherited automatic-fade flags, unknown selector attributes, warp, nonempty fades/curve, nonunit or unsupported transform, alternate file/segment, rate mismatch and changed asset/source hash reject without publishing output.
Gain and source-processing tests must not count generic app track automation or mixer output as native evidence.
Ordinary project playback/mix/DAWproject remain rejected after successful event-local export, including a source with other unsupported track content.
